ab26e6144ce1ef52.description: We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Sous Chef to join the production team of a fast-growing company operating across multiple markets. You will play a key role in overseeing the day-to-day operations of the kitchen, ensuring every order is produced on time, to the required quality standards, and in line with food safety and operational requirements. In this role, you will have end-to-end responsibility for the kitchen floor, overseeing multiple production sections including cake artistry, decorating, baking, chocolate, and stewarding. You will lead and develop the kitchen team, manage daily production against order volumes, maintain quality and food-safety standards, and drive efficient use of people, ingredients, and resources. Responsibilities Oversee the day-to-day operations of all kitchen and production sections, including cake artistry, decorating, baking, chocolate, and stewarding. Manage daily production plans and ensure orders are completed accurately and on time. Monitor recipe adherence and finished-product quality against required standards. Identify and resolve quality issues before products reach dispatch. Manage kitchen inventory levels in coordination with Procurement and Inventory teams, minimizing stockouts and unnecessary waste. Build and adjust staff schedules based on daily order volumes and production requirements. Allocate workloads across sections to ensure efficient use of the kitchen team. Lead, coach, and hold section heads and their teams accountable for performance, quality, and productivity. Conduct daily production briefings to communicate order volumes, priorities, special requests, and operational requirements. Identify training and development needs across the kitchen team and work with HR on onboarding and employee development. Enforce food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards across the facility. Work closely with the QC team to maintain consistent food-safety and quality standards. Own escalations related to design, product quality, rework, and delivery timelines. Make decisions on whether products require rework, should be held, or are ready for release. Monitor and report kitchen performance, including production output, quality, and on-time completion. Manage key kitchen cost drivers including labor, ingredients, and wastage against the facility budget. Develop capacity plans for peak periods and ensure all sections are prepared for increased production volumes. Identify opportunities to improve kitchen workflows, layouts, processes, and overall productivity. Act as the senior decision-maker on kitchen equipment, workflow, and operational changes affecting production. Work cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, and other teams on new launches, seasonal collections, and production planning. Maintain a clean, organized, safe, and efficient kitchen environment. 7-10 years of professional kitchen, bakery, or food production experience. Previous experience managing a multi-section kitchen, bakery, or high-volume production facility. Strong knowledge of cake production and decoration, including expert-level fondant and cake-craft skills. Excellent eye for detail with a strong understanding of product quality and presentation. Proven experience managing and developing a multi-person kitchen team. Strong experience with staff scheduling, coaching, performance management, and team development. Working knowledge of inventory management, food cost, wastage, and production planning. Strong understanding of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP principles. Ability to manage production efficiently against changing order volumes and tight deadlines. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure. Strong leadership and communication skills. Commercially aware with an understanding of kitchen budgets and cost control. Highly organized with strong attention to detail and operational follow-through. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume production environment. Hands-on leadership style with a willingness to be involved in day-to-day kitchen operations.

ab56bbd8b96500e5.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع عيادات الطبية عن فني أشعة للانضمام إلى فريقه في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في مدينتي قرية العليا والقريات. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تجهيز معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية، وإعداد المرضى، وتشغيل الأجهزة لضمان الحصول على صور شعاعية دقيقة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد أجهزة التصوير بالأشعة السينية بشكل دوري لضمان جاهزيتها وسلامتها. تأمين ومراقبة مستلزمات التصوير الضرورية مثل الأفلام والأدوية. اتخاذ جميع إجراءات الوقاية الشخصية اللازمة لحماية النفس والمرضى من التعرض غير الضروري للأشعة. تنظيم مواعيد المرضى بكفاءة وتوجيههم إلى غرفة التصوير. تحديد أجزاء الجسم المراد تصويرها وتحديد طبيعة الصورة الشعاعية ومواصفات الأشعة المطلوبة بناءً على طلب الطبيب المعالج. تثبيت ألواح من الرصاص لحماية الأجزاء الجسدية التي يجب ألا تتعرض للأشعة. توجيه وضبط أجهزة التصوير، واختيار مدة وشدة التعرض للأشعة، والتقاط الصور الشعاعية. إظهار وتثبيت الصور الشعاعية، وتضمين المعلومات الأساسية عليها، وتقديمها لطبيب أخصائي الأشعة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الأشعة. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والوقاية في بيئة العمل. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأشعة ضمن فريق مجمع عيادات الطبية في منطقة الجوف، في بيئة داعمة تركز على تقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. يتطلب الدور التواجد في قرية العليا والقريات. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق طبي متخصص والمساهمة في تقديم خدمات التصوير التشخيصي. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

Process securities settlements, cash movements, and custody instructions accurately and within market deadlines. Perform daily cash and securities reconciliations and investigate settlement exceptions. Process corporate actions, including dividends, stock splits, rights issues, and other entitlement events for Saudi and International securities. Monitor failed trades and coordinate with brokers, custodians, counterparties, and internal teams for timely resolution. Maintain accurate operational records and prepare daily operational reports. Support client asset protection, operational controls, and regulatory compliance efforts. Coordinate with Saudi Exchange, Muqassa, Edaa, custodian banks, global custodians, and other market participants. Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), process improvements, and operational projects. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. 1–3 years of experience in custody, settlement, brokerage, or banking operations. Exposure to both the Saudi Capital Market and International Markets is preferred. Experience Level This role requires 2-5 years of relevant professional experience. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province.

ab37cf0ed5f871fe.description: About the Role Comarch is seeking an experienced and proactive Senior OSS Support Engineer (Kubernetes / K8s) to join its technical operations team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role involves providing advanced (L2) technical support to major telecom and network operators, focusing on analyzing and resolving complex software issues and managing application deployments in cloud and Kubernetes environments. The position requires 5-10 years of experience and involves leading and coordinating tasks within a dedicated technical team. Key Responsibilities Provide L2 technical support to customers, investigating and resolving software errors reported by operator technical staff. Manage bugs and incidents, including resolving issues from test environments, performing retests of bugfixes, and monitoring ticket status to ensure SLA compliance. React to events and alerts from monitoring systems to prevent service disruptions. Oversee application and data management, including the installation of full software releases, single patches, and hotfixes across cloud and Kubernetes platforms. Coordinate tasks, shift schedules, and daily work distribution within the local technical support group. Collaborate with Production, Research & Development (R&D), and Delivery departments to escalate issues and improve product quality. Create, maintain, and update technical documentation for problem-solving processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Required Qualifications and Skills Extensive OSS Experience: Deep, hands-on experience with Operations Support Systems (OSS) software, with a mandatory focus on Fault Management, Performance Management, and Service Desk operations. Cloud & Kubernetes Mastery: Mandatory, hands-on production experience and deep operational knowledge of modern cloud environments and container orchestration using Kubernetes (K8s), including pod/cluster diagnostics and troubleshooting. Support Domain Expertise: Proven professional background in a Support Domain (*, NOC, Application Teams, or Systems Integrator). Telco Network Knowledge: Strong foundational knowledge of Telco Networks and telecom industry operations (gained on either the operator or vendor side). ITIL Certification: An active, valid ITIL certificate is strictly required. Leadership & Coordination: Experience managing a small team or actively coordinating work, tasks, and shifts within a technical group. Technical Troubleshooting: Strong root-cause analysis skills involving SQL, Linux, system logs, APIs, and scripting. Education: A University Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Telecommunications Engineering. Language: Fluency in English (written and spoken). Location: Based in Dammam or open to relocation. Additional Assets Kubernetes certification (*, CKA, CKAD). Hands-on experience with Business Support Systems (BSS) software. Proficiency in the Arabic language. Previous experience leading a small team. Benefits Support during planned maintenance windows, upgrades, and major releases. Competitive salary and stable employment with over 30 years of market presence. Professional growth opportunities and access to a global knowledge base. Opportunity to join an international leader in digital transformation.

ab4d5370da7cb536.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد اللازمة، والإشراف على تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف المشاريع (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها بدقة. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية المطلوبة، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، والإشراف على تشغيل دارات التمديدات، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية الأداء. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. فهم شامل لمخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد حلولها. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات قوية في تحليل المخططات الفنية. القدرة على تقدير الكميات والمواد بدقة. الالتزام بتطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والعمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور متاح في حائل ضمن مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات، ويتطلب التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل. يتم العمل في بيئة احترافية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

ab51c9f3433c82e5.description: نبحث في "جزيرة الأطفال" عن موظفة لبقة ومتميزة بمسمى (كاشير وخدمة عملاء) لتنضم إلى فريقنا بفرع الأندلس مول - جدة. أنتِ الواجهة الأولى التي تستقبل الأطفال وعائلاتهم والمسؤولة عن منحهم انطباعاً أولياً رائعاً يعكس مستوى الخدمة والترفيه لدينا. المهام والمسؤوليات: استقبال الزوار بترحيب حار وابتسامة، وتقديم معلومات واضحة عن باقات اللعب والعروض المتاحة. إدارة عمليات البيع وإصدار التذاكر عبر نظام الكاشير بدقة وسرعة لضمان انسيابية دخول الزوار. استلام المدفوعات (نقداً أو عبر البطاقات) والتأكد من مطابقتها وإغلاق الصندوق بدقة في نهاية الوردية. الرد على استفسارات العملاء وحل المشكلات البسيطة بمرونة، واحترافية، وإيجابية. الحفاظ على تنظيم وهدوء منطقة الاستقبال لتوفير تجربة مريحة للأهالي. المتطلبات: مهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة عالية على التعامل اللطيف مع الأطفال وأولياء الأمور. مظهر مهني لائق وروح إيجابية ومرحة تناسب بيئة العمل الترفيهية. مهارات حسابية جيدة وانتباه عالٍ للتفاصيل لمنع الأخطاء المالية. الالتزام بالمواعيد والقدرة على العمل بنظام الورديات (الصباحية/المسائية) وعطلات نهاية الأسبوع. المميزات وساعات العمل: بيئة عمل ممتعة، حيوية، ومليئة بالطاقة والبهجة. رواتب ومكافآت مجزية تحدد حسب الكفاءة. ساعات العمل: نظام ورديات متغيرة (6 أيام عمل في الأسبوع / يوم إجازة متغير). موقع العمل والمقابلات: الموقع: جدة - الأندلس مول (الدور الأول) - فرع جزيرة الأطفال. التقديم: عبر تطبيق صبار،او زيارة فرعنا وسيتم التواصل مع المرشحات لتحديد موعد المقابلات الشخصية في الفرع.

abf5c641d2ecee19.description: About the Role EHIF is seeking an experienced Project Engineering Manager to lead and coordinate small to mid-range projects within the fertilizers (phosphate, ammonia, urea) and mining & metals sectors (aluminum, gold, copper). This is a full-time, office-based position with a focus on engineering oversight, project planning, technical coordination, cost and schedule control, procurement support, and stakeholder alignment. The role requires 20 years of relevant experience. Project Scope and Focus This position manages projects through concept development, feasibility assessment, basic engineering, detailed design oversight, procurement follow-up, and preparation for execution. The primary objective is to ensure all engineering deliverables meet quality, cost, and schedule objectives. The role emphasizes office-driven project leadership and strong coordination between engineering teams, internal departments, and site representatives, rather than direct construction management. Occasional short site visits may be required for specific technical reviews. Key Responsibilities Manage P&L with associated commercial and financial accountability, including revenue delivery, margin and overhead management, budget and forecast determination, risk and opportunity reviews, cost controls, accounts payable/billing, and cash collection. Contribute to and review project proposals and plans to determine timeframe, procedures, staffing requirements, and resource allocation. Negotiate changes to project scope or specifications with customers and follow the Change Management process for modifications. Pursue and develop opportunities for innovation, such as digitalization, technology use, work share, and high-value engineering centers. Establish project procedures and lead the production of project execution plans, including scope of work, deliverables list, master schedule, budget, organizational charts, and risk register. Report project progress regularly to senior management and/or customers. Ensure delivery of agreed schedule and financial performance, proactively intervening to prevent slippage. Lead ongoing focus on risk identification and mitigation during project execution. Be responsible for project HSSE leadership, ensuring a program of initiatives and auditing schedule are established, and that HSSE and quality management issues are proactively addressed. Guide and direct a multidiscipline project team, which may include external specialists and staff from multiple offices and sites. Ensure project team members are competent to carry out assigned duties. Promote and establish a performance improvement culture and actions on complex projects and within their supply chains. Facilitate the setup of information management systems/applications as applicable to suit various life phases of projects and manage the information management project team. Participate in assurance activities and peer reviews. Employee Benefits EHIF provides a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employee well-being and professional growth. These benefits include: Medical Insurance: Coverage for employees and eligible family members residing in the country, including pre-existing conditions. Age and coverage limits apply in line with KSA CCHI rules. Employee Assistance Programme: Confidential support for work or personal issues, promoting mental, physical, social, and financial well-being. GOSI (Social Insurance): Contributions paid by the company for KSA employees in line with government legislation. End of Service Gratuity: Provided in line with KSA Labour Law. Examination Leave: Fully paid leave for examinations of an unrepeated year, subject to company approval and advance application. Professional Memberships: Reimbursement for one professional membership, registration, subscription, certification, and/or license per annum relevant to the role or development plan. Inspire Awards: An annual program recognizing and celebrating colleagues who demonstrate inspirational contributions. Long Service Award: Recognition for employees at 5-year service milestones. Career Development Champions: Structured growth through goal setting, resource utilization, and active coaching and mentoring. About Wood Wood, an Energy & Materials pillar of Sidara, is a global leader in consulting, engineering, and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in approximately 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future.

ab61a014f08a241c.description: About the Role Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Cashier for Food & Beverage Services in Mecca, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This contract position involves managing all payment methods, ensuring accurate cash handling, and maintaining a professional and organized workstation. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Process all payment methods in accordance with Accounting procedures and policies. Adhere to property control audit standards and cash handling procedures, including blind drops. Obtain and verify assigned bank, ensuring accuracy of contracted monies and securing the bank at all times. Obtain necessary change for expected business levels. Count the bank at the end of each shift, complete designated cashier reports, and resolve any discrepancies. Drop off receipts and secure the bank. Transport the bank to and from the assigned workstation. Set up and organize the cashier workstation with designated supplies, forms, and resource materials. Maintain the cleanliness and orderliness of the workstation at all times. Complete opening duties, including setting up necessary supplies and tools, and ensuring all equipment is in working order. Operational Duties Follow all company safety and security policies and procedures. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Communicate with others using clear and professional language. Answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues and support the team in achieving common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point-of-sale systems. Physical Requirements Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods of time. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Qualifications 0-1 years of experience in a similar role. Proficiency in processing various payment methods. Familiarity with point-of-sale systems. Work Environment This is a contract position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within the hospitality sector at Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts. The role involves direct interaction with guests and adherence to established company and safety protocols.

ab8e3adf6dc54ec9.description: About the Role CSG is seeking a Director Service Management to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is responsible for supporting the regional team by driving managed services pursuits within designated regions. The role focuses on securing Managed Services (MS) contracts, fostering business growth, overseeing existing MS contracts, and driving commercial contract management and business improvement initiatives. Role Context and Leadership The Director Service Management will provide effective internal leadership, collaborating across various functions and regional teams to leverage CSG's assets into successful MS solutions. This includes combining technical, service, and commercial aspects. Contributions from this role are essential for positioning CSG at a senior level with customers and partners as a key enabler for their success in Managed Services. Key Responsibilities Assist regional sales teams in identifying suitable Managed Services opportunities. Participate in the qualification process for MS sales. Support the execution of regional go-to-market plans. Manage and drive a standardized approach across CSG for solution, service design, and commercials in MS sales pursuits, adhering to CSG’s MS engagement model. Lead MS sales pursuits, integrating technical, service, and commercial solutions in collaboration with CSG functions including sales, presales, finance, PS, and operations, as per the CSG MS engagement model. Oversee MS contracts within the assigned region and contribute to driving commercial and operational performance improvement. Collaborate with Global Operations and Global Services to effectively implement the MS Target Operating Model (TOM) and MS Engagement model for the region. Implement MS commercial and service capabilities for the assigned region. Support the development of MS onsite operational and contract P&L management capabilities. Contribute to organizational development to establish and replicate necessary skills for effective MS execution. Provide input to MS business strategy and planning. Qualifications and Professional Conduct A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Regular and reliable attendance is expected. The incumbent is accountable for professional working behavior, including building and maintaining constructive working relationships, implementing proactive and concise communication, acting as a resource to colleagues, and engaging in collaborative thinking and problem-solving while demonstrating CSG’s core competencies and values. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring a commitment to professional engagement within a dynamic regional team environment.

abf0b700313216a5.job_title: فرص عمل موسمية للسعوديين – محاسب زبائن (كاشير)
abf0b700313216a5.description: فرصة عمل موسمية – محاسب زبائن (كاشير) نبحث عن محاسبي زبائن سعوديين، ممن تزيد أعمارهم على 18 عامًا، للعمل لمدة شهر في فروع الشركة بجميع أنحاء المملكة. تفاصيل العمل: الراتب الشهري: 3,000 ريال سعودي. ساعات العمل: 9 ساعات يوميًا، تشمل ساعة راحة. الإجازة الأسبوعية: يومان. المهام والمسؤوليات: استقبال العملاء وتقديم خدمة مميزة. تسجيل المنتجات وإتمام عمليات البيع عبر نظام نقاط البيع. تحصيل المدفوعات النقدية والإلكترونية بدقة. مطابقة النقدية مع تقارير المبيعات وتسليم العهدة. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب منطقة الكاشير. إبلاغ المشرف عن أي فروقات مالية أو مشكلات أثناء العمل. المتطلبات: سعودي الجنسية، والعمر أكبر من 18 عامًا. التفرغ للعمل طوال مدة الشهر. الالتزام بالمواعيد والاستعداد للعمل بنظام الورديات. مهارات جيدة في التواصل وخدمة العملاء. الدقة والأمانة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. تُعطى الأولوية لمن لديه بطاقة بلدية «شهادة صحية» سارية أو فحص طبي ساري المفعول.

ab17e10d43f9b697.description: About the Role Swissport KSA is seeking a QHSE Officer to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves monitoring, implementing, and maintaining Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental standards across Swissport's airport ground handling operations. The QHSE Officer ensures compliance with corporate QHSE policies, Saudi Arabian regulations, GACA requirements, and international aviation safety standards. Key Responsibilities Monitor compliance with Swissport safety policies, operational procedures, and airport safety regulations. Conduct regular safety inspections across ramp, passenger services, baggage handling, and cargo operations. Identify unsafe acts, hazardous conditions, and operational risks, recommending corrective actions. Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the Safety Management System (SMS). Ensure compliance with GACA requirements, airport authority regulations, and Swissport Global Standards. Conduct scheduled and unannounced operational inspections and quality checks. Support internal and external audits, including airline customer audits and regulatory inspections. Participate in investigations of aircraft damage, ground support equipment incidents, employee injuries, and other operational occurrences. Collect evidence, interview personnel, and prepare investigation reports, supporting root cause analysis. Monitor occupational health and workplace safety practices, conducting inspections to identify hazards. Support emergency response preparedness, evacuation drills, and safety exercises. Conduct safety briefings, toolbox talks, and awareness campaigns, identifying safety training needs. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly QHSE inspection and performance reports. Maintain accurate records of safety observations, incidents, investigations, audits, and corrective actions. Authority and Accountability The QHSE Officer is authorized to report unsafe practices and non-compliance directly to QHSE management and recommend immediate suspension of unsafe activities where company procedures allow. This role involves requesting corrective actions from operational departments and escalating serious safety risks, incidents, and repeated violations to management. The Officer is accountable for the accuracy of QHSE reporting, timely escalation of significant risks, and objective performance of assigned duties. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental roles, preferably within airport ground handling or a similar operational environment. A strong understanding of aviation safety standards, GACA requirements, and international regulations such as IATA Ground Operations Manual (IGOM) and ISAGO standards is essential. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within Swissport KSA's airport ground handling operations. The role requires active engagement across various operational areas, promoting a proactive safety culture and continuous improvement.

ab6effb8dfc911f1.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Sous Chef to join its team in Medina, Al Madinah. This full-time role is responsible for the overall success of daily kitchen operations, demonstrating culinary talent while leading staff and managing all food-related functions. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Manage kitchen shift operations and ensure compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards, and procedures. Estimate daily production needs weekly and communicate these needs to kitchen personnel daily. Assist the Executive Chef with all kitchen operations and food preparation. Prepare and cook various types of food, both for regular service and special guests or functions. Develop, design, or create new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions. Assist in determining food presentation and create decorative food displays. Maintain purchasing, receiving, and food storage standards. Ensure compliance with food handling and sanitation standards, as well as all applicable laws and regulations. Perform duties of kitchen managers and employees as necessary. Recognize superior quality products, presentations, and flavor. Follow proper handling and temperature guidelines for all food products. Operate and maintain all department equipment and report malfunctions. Check the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure standards are met. Leadership and Team Management Supervise and coordinate activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation. Lead shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications. Utilize interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocate sound financial/business decision-making; demonstrate honesty/integrity; lead by example. Encourage and build mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members. Serve as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors. Maintain the productivity level of employees and ensure they understand expectations and parameters. Establish and maintain open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensure employees do the same within the team. Ensure property policies are administered fairly and consistently. Communicate performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position. Recognize successful performance and produce desired results. Customer Service and Goal Achievement Provide services that exceed customer expectations for satisfaction and retention. Manage day-to-day operations, ensuring quality, standards, and meeting customer expectations daily. Set a positive example for guest relations and empower employees to provide excellent customer service. Interact with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels, and handle guest problems and complaints. Achieve and exceed goals, including performance, budget, and team goals. Develop specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work. Utilize the Labor Management System for effective scheduling based on business demands and for tracking employee time and attendance. Train employees in safety procedures. Human Resources and Administrative Duties Identify developmental needs of others and provide coaching, mentoring, or other assistance to improve knowledge or skills. Improve service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed. Participate in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as necessary. Bring issues to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources as necessary. Provide information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates via telephone, written form, email, or in person. Analyze information and evaluate results to choose the best solution and solve problems. Attend and participate in all pertinent meetings. Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in a culinary role. Demonstrated leadership skills in a kitchen environment. Strong understanding of culinary standards, food handling, and sanitation regulations. Ability to manage daily kitchen operations and ensure high-quality product production.

abba540dd0649657.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الباب العالي السعودية عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية للمشاريع، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وإعداد برامج الصيانة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات لخطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية، بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر، ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم فيها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. مهارات في تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتطلب الوظيفة التواجد في الموقع لمتابعة المشاريع وتنفيذ المهام. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

abc29403ab16751d.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Pastry Chef to join its team in Makkah. ab3323450f75518d.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة جهة للتجارة عن مشرف موقع إنشائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تطبيق القواعد واللوائح الخاصة بالإنشاءات في المواقع المختلفة، والمساهمة في الحفاظ على معايير السلامة والجودة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة مدى التزام المواقع الإنشائية بالقواعد واللوائح المعمول بها. الإبلاغ عن أي مخالفات وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها. متابعة تنفيذ الإجراءات التصحيحية في المواقع الإنشائية لضمان فعاليتها. مراجعة المخططات الأولية والخطط الخاصة بمشاريع الإنشاءات. إصدار تراخيص للمضي قدماً في الأعمال بعد التأكد من الالتزام بالمتطلبات. فحص الأنظمة المختلفة مثل أجهزة الرفع والنقل والممرات الجانبية المتحركة، والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المطلوبة. تطبيق إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في الإشراف على المواقع الإنشائية. فهم عميق للقواعد واللوائح الخاصة بالإنشاءات. القدرة على تحديد المخالفات واقتراح الحلول التصحيحية. مهارات ممتازة في المتابعة والتنسيق. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على قراءة ومراجعة المخططات الهندسية. مهارات تواصل فعالة مع فرق العمل المختلفة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. يعمل مشرف الموقع الإنشائي ضمن فريق مخصص لضمان جودة المشاريع وسلامة العمليات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل التوظيف.

abbe6c64d94cc2a8.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة صفوة المهيدب لطب الأسنان عن طبيب أخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، مع التركيز على تشخيص الحالات المرضية ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعتها. الهدف من الدور يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم رعاية طبية متخصصة من خلال دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية في مجال التخصص، ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم تطور الحالة المرضية. كما يشمل الدور مسؤولية إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمرضى. المسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية الشاملة من المريض وذويه لدراسة الحالة بدقة. إجراء الفحص السريري اللازم وطلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية والصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية عند الحاجة. قراءة وتفسير النتائج والتقارير لتشخيص الحالة المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية ومدى فاعلية الخطة العلاجية المطبقة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بكل مريض وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات شهادة جامعية في الطب مع تخصص ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى وذويهم. بيئة العمل يعمل الطبيب الأخصائي ضمن فريق طبي في عيادات صفوة المهيدب لطب الأسنان في منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

ab4be6cadce36225.description: نبذة عن مهندس ميكانيكي في صروح الاستثمار للمقاولات تبحث شركة صروح الاستثمار للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في سكاكا، الجوف. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى برامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات والمعدات الصناعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع أعمال الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة قوية ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة تنفيذها. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة سكاكا بمنطقة الجوف. سيعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص في صروح الاستثمار للمقاولات، وستكون له فرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع متنوعة. نظرة عامة على الدور يُعد هذا الدور أساسياً لضمان كفاءة وفعالية المشاريع الميكانيكية للشركة. يشمل الدور مسؤوليات متعددة تتراوح من التصميم إلى الإشراف على التشغيل والصيانة، مما يتطلب مهارات فنية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. نشجع المهندسين الميكانيكيين ذوي الخبرة المناسبة على التقديم لهذه الفرصة في صروح الاستثمار للمقاولات.

ab66f3aba1d786b3.description: Project Manager – Smart Home & CCTV Systems (KNX & Zigbee) Job Description : Nexura is seeking an experienced and highly skilled engineer to join the team as a Project Manager. The role involves overseeing the execution of Smart Home, CCTV, and Low Current Systems projects. The ideal candidate should possess advanced technical expertise in KNX and Zigbee systems, combined with strong project management capabilities, the ability to supervise engineering and technical teams, and a commitment to delivering projects to the highest quality standards, on time and within budget. The position also requires excellent communication and persuasion skills, the ability to coordinate with internal and external suppliers, and a professional appearance. Key Responsibilities : • Fully manage Smart Home (KNX & Zigbee) and CCTV projects from the design and planning stage through to final handover. • Design appropriate technical solutions based on client requirements and approved specifications. • Supervise engineers, technicians, and subcontractors, and monitor the quality of installation, programming, and commissioning. • Conduct regular site visits to ensure work complies with drawings and technical specifications. • Review technical drawings and specifications, and monitor project timelines, budgets, and material procurement. • Coordinate lighting, HVAC, security, access control, and networking systems. • Identify and resolve technical and execution challenges to ensure smooth project progress. • Communicate directly with clients and provide regular progress reports. • Coordinate and communicate with internal and external suppliers to ensure timely availability of materials and equipment. • Prepare progress reports and final handover documentation, and follow up on after-sales technical support. Requirements & Qualifications : • Minimum of 5 years of practical experience in Smart Home and CCTV projects, including at least 3 years in KNX system projects. • Hands-on experience in programming, configuration, and commissioning of KNX systems using ETS software. • Good knowledge of Zigbee systems and the ability to integrate them into smart home solutions. • Experience supervising engineers and technicians and managing technical teams. • Ability to design technical solutions, prepare drawings, and coordinate with relevant parties. • Advanced knowledge of IP cameras, NVR/DVR systems, and networking. • Ability to read electrical and technical drawings and coordinate on-site installation works. • Strong communication skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. • Ability to effectively communicate and coordinate with internal and external suppliers. • Strong speaking and persuasion skills with a professional and presentable appearance. • Valid driving license and willingness to conduct regular site visits. • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, or a related field. • KNX Partner certification is preferred. Preferred Skills • Experience in residential villas, luxury homes, and commercial projects. • Knowledge of Access Control, Intercom, and Low Current systems. • Ability to prepare technical proposals and assess client requirements. • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in KNX and Zigbee systems. We are looking for a professional engineer who combines high technical competence in KNX and Zigbee systems with the ability to lead and supervise projects to the highest standards of quality and professionalism, while demonstrating excellent communication, persuasion skills, and a professional appearance.

ab503ac7f5db384b.description: Job Title: Information Security Specialist – Penetration Tester Job Description: NOZOM is seeking an Information Security Specialist with hands-on experience in penetration testing. The successful candidate will assess networks, applications, endpoints, wireless environments, and cloud platforms to identify security vulnerabilities and provide effective remediation recommendations. Key Responsibilities: Conduct penetration testing for internal networks, web applications, endpoints, wireless networks, and cloud environments. Identify, exploit, validate, and document security vulnerabilities. Perform secure code reviews and identify authentication flaws, hardcoded credentials, and insecure logic. Participate in advanced Red Team exercises and multi-stage attack simulations. Assess cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Oracle. Prepare detailed technical and executive reports. Present findings to stakeholders and support remediation validation. Qualifications and Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field. Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in information security services. Fluency in Arabic is required. Experience in vulnerability assessment, exploitation, web application testing, and network protocol analysis. Knowledge of cloud security assessment and privilege escalation risks. Strong technical reporting, documentation, and communication skills. One or more of the following certifications is preferred: OSCP, GPEN, GWAPT, GXPN, eCPPT, eWPT, or eWPTX.

abd6556aceecd81c.description: Overview The Electrician is responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing electrical systems, equipment, and wiring in residential, commercial, and industrial environments. The role ensures all electrical systems operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable electrical codes, safety standards, and regulations. Your Role As an Electrician, you will be responsible for carrying out reactive maintenance and Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) activities for LV/MV systems, low-current systems, and control panels. You will act as a first responder to electrical issues, work closely with supervisors on a daily basis, and ensure compliance with BEC standards and client contractual FMA & FMR requirements. Key Responsibilities Install, maintain, repair, and troubleshoot electrical systems, including wiring, lighting, power distribution, and control systems within commercial and industrial facilities. Perform regular inspections and preventive maintenance activities to identify potential issues and ensure optimal performance of electrical systems. Diagnose and rectify faults in electrical systems and equipment, including: Fire Alarm Control Panels (FACP) Building Management Systems (BMS) Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems Public Address and Voice Alarm (PAVA) systems Fan motors and pumps Control panels Lighting panels Distribution panels Circuit breakers Lighting fixtures Conduct routine cleaning, servicing, and maintenance of electrical components to ensure operational efficiency. Collaborate with maintenance teams to coordinate and prioritize work orders, ensuring timely completion of assigned tasks. Maintain accurate records of maintenance and repair activities, including equipment status, work performed, and materials used. Diagnose and repair system malfunctions requiring specialized technical knowledge and qualifications. Seek technical clarification and support when necessary and escalate issues appropriately. Stay informed of industry developments, emerging technologies, and best practices related to electrical systems. Ensure strict adherence to company safety procedures, regulations, and electrical standards. Provide guidance and support to junior technicians when required. Demonstrate working knowledge of building automation and control systems. Follow up with supervisors to ensure activities and events are closed within agreed timelines. Respond promptly to service requests and emergency callouts, minimizing downtime and operational disruptions. Assist in the installation, testing, and commissioning of new electrical systems and equipment. Ensure all work complies with relevant electrical codes, standards, and safety regulations. Perform any other duties assigned by management. Qualifications About You High School Diploma or equivalent. Technical Certification, ITI, or Diploma in Electrical Engineering preferred. Valid Electrician License/Certification (where required by local regulations). Experience Minimum 5 years of experience as an Electrician in residential, commercial, or industrial environments. Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of electrical systems, circuits, wiring, and safety procedures. Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, blueprints, and schematics. Proficiency in diagnosing and repairing electrical faults and equipment failures. Familiarity with local electrical codes, regulations, and industry standards. Hands-on experience using electrical testing and diagnostic instruments. Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities. Physical capability to work at heights, in confined spaces, and across various site environments. Strong communication, teamwork, and time-management skills. Knowledge of building automation systems and controls is an advantage. Rewards & Benefits At AtkinsRéalis, we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to support you throughout your career and personal life. Benefits Include Tax-free salary Life insurance coverage Medical insurance Annual leave entitlement Company gratuity scheme Discretionary bonus program Annual flight contribution Transportation allowance Housing allowance Employee Wellbeing Program featuring 24/7 access to specialists in: Financial advice Legal support Family care Personal health and wellness Fitness and nutrition Take advantage of continuous learning opportunities, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make. abf8dd1d3cd4d279.description: Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. What Will You Do❓ Own problems end to end. Take ambiguous business problems from discovery through design, build, launch, and iteration. Evaluate and adopt languages, frameworks, and platforms based on the problem, not habit. What Are We Looking For❓ 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and owning production systems. A product mindset: you care about the user and the business outcome, not just the ticket. You can explain why something should be built, not only how. Experience building AI-powered product features (LLM integrations, RAG, agents, evaluation). Cloud infrastructure and DevOps experience (containers, CI/CD, observability). Experience with B2B or merchant-facing products. What We Offer You❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.
